Smart Citations, Assistant, Search, Collections, Reference Check, API, MCP, Zotero and browser extension are capabilities/integrations, not separate product entities. Historical Scite/Scite.ai spellings refer to this product; no alternate canonical is approved.

Basic/Pro/Team/Enterprise displayed pricing and feature gates, yearly billing toggle, 7-day trial auto-enrollment, API/MCP allowances; no checkout or account testing.
Smart Citations, Assistant, Search, Reports, Collections and Reference Check workflows; vendor-described corpus counts are not completeness measures.
API capability/availability boundary; account-specific limits, commercial data rights and overages not verified.

Privacy policy effective 2026-03-26; searches/usage analytics are collected, Customer Data is not used to train/fine-tune/improve AI systems, retention varies by data purpose with account data potentially retained for ten years after account closure subject to applicable law.

Service terms; Customer Data training exclusion, user responsibility for source/citation judgments, article/classifier-result licensing, no bulk/systematic retrieval beyond own research needs and no third-party redistribution or model training from service content.
Public contact route customersupport@researchsolutions.com; no contact made. This does not establish an accepted correction route on our own future listing.

independentEvidence.actualUseDate: Institution subscription status/date not established on captured page
independentEvidence.observation: The Hong Kong Polytechnic University Pao Yue-kong Library maintains a Scite database page with institutional access guidance and copyright restrictions. This is a customer-side adoption signal, not proof of every current feature or usage volume.

independentEvidence.actualUseDate: Institutional access announced 2026-04-01; notice says subscription available through 2027-03-30
independentEvidence.observation: Charles University Faculty of Mathematics and Physics Library reports institution-network access and remote access with institutional email through 2027-03-30. Demonstrates actual institutional subscription/access at notice date; does not establish present user activity, accuracy, or general market scale.

independentEvidence.actualUseDate: Study conducted before publication; exact data collection dates not reported in reviewed passages
independentEvidence.observation: Bakker, Theis-Mahon & Brown evaluated Scite classifications for a sample of citations to retracted pharmacy papers in systematic reviews. In that bounded sample 31% of citations were absent, 37.7% were unclassified for lack of full-text access, and the authors found low recall for supporting/contrasting classes. This is historical, domain-specific evidence, not a current global performance estimate.

identity.finding: Scite.ai research application, now part of Research Solutions; do not confuse Scite with similarly named products or classify product modules/integrations as separate tools.

capabilities.finding: Smart Citations display citation context with supporting/contrasting/mentioning model labels; Search finds full-text citation statements; Assistant produces source-linked answers; Reference Check analyzes manuscript references for citation context, retraction/editorial notices and contrasting statements; Collections monitor papers/citations.

availability.finding: Public web application and 7-day trial path are documented. No account login, checkout, generation, region-by-region access or entitlement test performed.

plans.observed: Current page displays Basic $20/month billed yearly; Pro $50/month billed yearly with $60 API credit marked limited-time; Team $250/month including eight seats with $50/month additional seats; Enterprise custom. Basic shows 250 MCP credits/month, Pro 2,500, Team 2,500/user. Seven-day trial auto-enrolls into the selected plan unless canceled.
unknown: Month-to-month checkout price, tax/region adjustments, promo expiry date, API overages, institutional negotiated rates, seat/usage contract details, product availability for a specific account.
plans.publication: Do not state a universal price or entitlement without target-account checkout confirmation. Numbers are dated public-page observations only.

coverage.vendorClaims: Official pages variously display 1.6B+ Smart Citations, 300M+/317M+ articles or scholarly sources, 49M+ full-text sources and 44+ publisher partners. These are vendor-reported counts with differing labels and no independently verified coverage denominator.
coverage.limit: Corpus availability depends on full text, publisher agreements, extraction, DOI/link matching, discipline, language and date. Missing or unclassified citations are possible. No evidence supports exhaustive coverage of publications, fields, citation statements, or the target user's sources.

classification.limit: The model classifies a citation statement/context, not whether an entire paper or scientific claim is true. The 2023 independent pharmacy/systematic-review sample found substantial missing/unclassified citations and low recall for support/contrast labels. Do not treat labels/count ratios as truth, study quality, replication, consensus or a systematic-review screening decision. Inspect the citing passage, methods, population and original paper.

exportApi.finding: Pro page advertises API access; official home lists API, MCP, Zotero and browser extension. API scope, rate/overage schedule, bulk export formats/limits, retention, derived-data redistribution, commercial reuse and institutional entitlement are not confirmed by public evidence captured here. Terms restrict systematic/bulk access and redistribution; access is not a republication license.

privacy.finding: The current Terms and Privacy Policy define Customer Data to include inputs, outputs, queries and usage data, and state it is not used to train, fine-tune or improve AI systems. The Privacy Policy also says searches/usage may be analyzed to improve the Service; these are distinct statements and must both be retained. Account data may be retained for up to ten years after account closure, with purpose-specific exceptions and rights under applicable law. Specific backups, deletion completion time and contractual/institutional controls remain unknown. Enterprise enhanced confidentiality remains a separate plan claim.

commercialAcademicUse.finding: Academic research use is the product's stated purpose. Commercial data extraction, redistribution of article text/citation statements, resale, derived datasets and API/MCP use remain subject to copyright, publisher licenses, plan terms and service restrictions; no blanket commercial republication right established.

items: Not a comprehensive bibliographic database or reproducible systematic-review search strategy by itself.
A missing/unclassified citation is not evidence of no supporting or contradicting work.
Citation labels can miss context and model classifications can be wrong; verify primary sources and study methods.
Full-text access depends on Scite/publisher or the user's institutional rights; a link or citation snippet is not full-text access.
Assistant's linked sources do not by themselves prove every generated synthesis statement.
No target-discipline benchmark, account-based workflow trial, export/API quota test, or language-specific performance test was run.

correction.finding: Vendor contact exists. Site-side visible correction/owner-update route and its operation on the proposed public Tool page have not been verified; publication remains blocked until a real user-facing route is connected and accepted.

conflicts.conflict: Official pages use differing counts/labels (300M+, 317M+, 49M+ full-text, 1.6B+ citations).
conflicts.resolution: HOLD exact count claims; retain each as vendor-reported and do not infer coverage percentage, completeness or accuracy.

conflicts.conflict: Page has annual-billing display, a limited-time API credit, trial auto-enrollment, and no verified target-account checkout; prior 2026-09-28 audit captured different promotional amounts and plan labels.
conflicts.resolution: The 2026-10-07 page is a new observation, not proof the older snapshot was universally wrong. Use current captured plan labels only as scoped observations; exact amount, monthly billing and institution/API terms remain HOLD/unknown.

conflicts.conflict: Vendor feature copy presents classification as a way to see citation treatment; independent 2023 bounded evaluation found substantial omissions and low support/contrast recall.
conflicts.resolution: Preserve both scopes. Model labels are discovery cues only; historical results do not quantify current global performance, and vendor framing does not invalidate independent findings.

conflicts.conflict: Terms and Privacy Policy explicitly exclude defined Customer Data (including queries and usage data) from AI training/improvement, while privacy language permits analyzing Service use to improve the Service and states account-data retention can extend ten years after closure. Enterprise separately advertises enhanced confidentiality.
conflicts.resolution: Preserve scopes: customer-input training exclusion is explicit; service analytics improvement is separately permitted; do not infer zero analytics, immediate deletion, backup purge, or Enterprise protections for individual plans. Contract-specific controls remain unknown.

deduplication.knownContext: The 2026-10-06 buffer records a read-only Neon name/title/url scan with zero matches and an existing research-guide mention; this is a dated, scoped snapshot, not a current cross-store release preflight. No second Scite entity or alias is proposed.
deduplication.required: Rerun production tools/profile and all route/alias/search-intent checks on release day. Do not create a Tool, relationship, Task Page, or synonym route in this unit.

Existing scite.svg/scite-cover.svg are not approved official assets. Need rights holder, allowed use/processing, attribution and current representative preview, then visual acceptance.

liveSignal.exit: Connect a working visible correction/owner-update path, test the actual rendered destination, and complete independent content/visual QA.

en.summary: Scite helps researchers inspect how indexed papers cite a work and find citation statements in scholarly full text. Its labels are useful leads for review, not verdicts on whether a paper or claim is true.
en.detail: Use Scite when you already have a paper, claim or reference list and want to inspect citation context, locate later supporting or contrasting discussion, or flag retractions and editorial notices. Search and Assistant can help surface relevant passages; open the cited work and judge its methods and context yourself. Coverage depends on available and licensed full text, and some citations may be absent or unclassified. This review used public documents and independent institutional/evaluation sources; it did not test a paid account, target discipline, export, API or live classification workflow.
bestFor: Researchers checking how indexed literature discusses a known paper or claim.
Authors and librarians seeking another signal for reference-list review, with source-level verification.
notIdealFor: Systematic reviews that need a complete, reproducible search from one database alone.
High-stakes evidence decisions based only on supporting/contrasting counts or AI answers.
Users needing verified account-level pricing, API/export rights or contractual protections before procurement.
limitations: Coverage is licensed and incomplete; missing or unclassified citations do not mean no evidence exists.
Citation labels classify local context and can miss nuance or be wrong; read the source paper.
A supporting/contrasting label does not establish truth, replication, quality or consensus.
Current target-account billing, API/export limits, and backup/deletion timing remain unknown.
en.pricingBoundary: The public pricing page currently shows Basic, Pro, Team and custom Enterprise with yearly-billing labels and a limited-time API credit. Treat these as dated page observations, not checkout guarantees; monthly billing, taxes, institution rates and account entitlements need confirmation. The seven-day trial automatically enrolls in the selected plan unless canceled.
en.privacyBoundary: Current Terms and Privacy Policy state that defined Customer Data, including inputs, outputs, queries and usage data, is not used to train or improve AI systems. The policy separately allows service-use analytics to improve the Service and says account data may be retained up to ten years after account closure, subject to applicable law. Backup purge and account-specific controls remain unknown; Enterprise confidentiality does not transfer to individual plans.
en.platforms: Browser application with listed Zotero, browser extension, MCP and API integrations. No account-level entitlement or operational integration test was performed.

decisionCard.verdict: Consider Scite as a citation-context and reference-audit aid when a human will verify the underlying papers.
decisionCard.chooseIf: You need to inspect indexed citation passages around known papers and can tolerate incomplete coverage and manual review.
decisionCard.skipIf: You need exhaustive systematic searching, guaranteed classification accuracy, or account-specific privacy/API terms today.
decisionCard.firstCheck: Search a known DOI in your target discipline; compare Scite results with the original citing papers and another scholarly database; record missing/unclassified references, then verify billing and data terms before uploading a manuscript.

compareNext.reason: Compare citation-context/reference-audit work with structured screening and extraction; neither is a replacement for a reproducible database search.
Compare citation tracing with question-led evidence discovery; different corpora and workflows must not be treated as equivalent.

decisionCard.evidenceBoundary: Official public product documents, two independent library subscription/access records, and a bounded historical peer-reviewed accuracy evaluation; no hands-on current account test.

cn.summary: Scite 帮助研究者查看已收录论文如何引用某项研究，并在学术全文中查找引文陈述。分类标签只能作为回查线索，不能判定论文或结论真伪。
cn.detail: 当你已有论文、论点或参考文献表，想查看引用语境、寻找后续支持或对照讨论，或发现撤稿与编辑告示时，可考虑 Scite。Search 和 Assistant 可帮助定位相关段落；仍需打开原文，自行判断研究方法与上下文。覆盖取决于可获取且获许可的全文，部分引用可能缺失或未分类。本次核读公开资料、独立机构采用与评估来源；没有测试付费账户、目标学科、导出、API 或实时分类流程。
bestFor: 需要检查已收录文献如何讨论某篇已知论文或论点的研究者。
希望为参考文献审阅增加一项线索、并会逐篇核对来源的作者与图书馆员。
notIdealFor: 要求单一数据库提供完整、可复现系统检索的综述项目。
只凭支持/对照数量或 AI 回答做高风险证据判断的人。
采购前必须确认账户级价格、API/导出权益或合同保护的用户。
limitations: 覆盖受许可与可用全文限制，且并不完整；未显示或未分类不代表不存在证据。
标签针对局部语境，可能遗漏细节或分类错误；应阅读原文。
支持/对照标签不能证明真伪、重复验证、研究质量或共识。
目标账户账单、API/导出限额与备份/删除时间仍未知。
cn.pricingBoundary: 当前公开价格页显示 Basic、Pro、Team 与定制 Enterprise，并标有年付和限时 API credit。它们只是核查日页面观察，并非结账保证；月付、税费、机构价与账户权益需另行确认。七天试用结束后会自动转入所选套餐，除非提前取消。
cn.privacyBoundary: 当前条款及隐私政策说明，定义范围内的 Customer Data（含输入、输出、查询和使用数据）不会用于训练或改进 AI 系统。政策另允许分析服务使用情况以改进服务，并称账户数据在关闭后可能保留最长十年，受适用法律约束。备份清除及账户专属控制仍未知；Enterprise 保密承诺不适用于个人套餐。
cn.platforms: 浏览器应用，并列有 Zotero、浏览器扩展、MCP 与 API 集成。本次未登录账户验证权益或实际运行集成。

decisionCard.verdict: 若有人逐篇核验原始论文，可把 Scite 作为引文语境与参考文献审阅辅助。
decisionCard.chooseIf: 你需要查看已知论文的已收录引文段落，并能接受覆盖不完整与人工复核。
decisionCard.skipIf: 你今天就需要穷尽式系统检索、分类准确保证或账户级隐私/API 条款。
decisionCard.firstCheck: 在目标学科用已知 DOI 检索，将 Scite 结果与原始引用论文及另一学术数据库对照；记录缺失/未分类项，再于上传稿件前确认计费与数据条款。

compareNext.reason: 比较引文语境/参考文献审阅与结构化筛选/提取；两者都不能代替可复现数据库检索。
比较引文追踪与问题导向证据发现；语料和工作流不同，不能视为等价。

decisionCard.evidenceBoundary: 官方公开产品资料、两项独立图书馆订阅/访问记录及一项范围有限的历史同行评审准确性研究；没有当前账户上手测试。

tw.summary: Scite 協助研究者查看已收錄論文如何引用某項研究，並在學術全文中搜尋引文陳述。分類標籤是供查核的線索，不能判定論文或主張真偽。
tw.detail: 若你已有論文、主張或參考文獻清單，想檢視引用脈絡、尋找後續支持或對照討論，或查看撤稿與編輯公告，可考慮 Scite。Search 和 Assistant 可協助找出相關段落；仍須開啟原文，自行判斷研究方法與脈絡。涵蓋範圍受可取得且獲授權的全文限制，部分引用可能缺漏或未分類。本次檢視公開資料、獨立機構採用與評估來源；未測試付費帳戶、目標學科、匯出、API 或即時分類流程。
bestFor: 需要檢查已收錄文獻如何討論某篇已知論文或主張的研究者。
想為參考文獻審查增加一項線索，並會逐篇核對來源的作者與圖書館員。
notIdealFor: 要求單一資料庫提供完整且可重現系統檢索的綜述計畫。
只依支持/對照數量或 AI 回答進行高風險證據判斷的人。
採購前必須確認帳戶層級價格、API/匯出權益或合約保障的使用者。
limitations: 涵蓋範圍受授權與全文可用性限制，並不完整；未顯示或未分類不代表沒有證據。
標籤判讀的是局部脈絡，可能漏掉細節或分類錯誤；應閱讀原文。
支持/對照標籤不能證明真偽、重複驗證、研究品質或共識。
目標帳戶計費、API/匯出限制及備份/刪除時間仍未知。
tw.pricingBoundary: 目前公開價格頁列出 Basic、Pro、Team 與客製 Enterprise，並標示年繳及限時 API credit。這些只是查核日頁面觀察，並非結帳保證；月繳、稅費、機構價格與帳戶權益仍須確認。七天試用結束後會自動轉為所選方案，除非事先取消。
tw.privacyBoundary: 目前條款及隱私政策說明，定義範圍內的 Customer Data（含輸入、輸出、查詢與使用資料）不會用於訓練或改進 AI 系統。政策另允許分析服務使用情況以改進服務，並稱帳戶資料在關閉後可能保留最長十年，受適用法律約束。備份清除及帳戶專屬控制仍未知；Enterprise 保密承諾不適用於個人方案。
tw.platforms: 瀏覽器應用程式，並列有 Zotero、瀏覽器擴充功能、MCP 與 API 整合。本次未登入帳戶確認權益或實際執行整合。

decisionCard.verdict: 若有人逐篇核對原始論文，可把 Scite 作為引文脈絡與參考文獻審查輔助。
decisionCard.chooseIf: 你需要檢視已知論文的已收錄引文段落，並能接受涵蓋不完整與人工複核。
decisionCard.skipIf: 你目前就需要窮盡式系統檢索、分類準確保證或帳戶層級隱私/API 條款。
decisionCard.firstCheck: 以目標學科的已知 DOI 搜尋，將 Scite 結果與原始引用論文及另一學術資料庫比較；記錄缺漏/未分類項，再於上傳稿件前確認計費與資料條款。

compareNext.reason: 比較引文脈絡/參考文獻審查與結構化篩選/擷取；兩者都不能取代可重現資料庫檢索。
比較引文追蹤與問題導向證據探索；語料與工作流程不同，不應視為等同。

decisionCard.evidenceBoundary: 官方公開產品資料、兩項獨立圖書館訂閱/存取紀錄及一項範圍有限的歷史同儕審查準確性研究；未進行目前帳戶上手測試。

Research Guide mention is contextual only; release-day recheck and site correction mechanism remain required under content gate.

releaseBoundary.preflight: Editorial candidate only. Resolve official/content holds and independent QA, then separately authorize any future monitor/noindex release; no automatic index, relationship or Task approval.
releaseBoundary.rollback: No production mutations were performed. Any later release needs before-state snapshots and separately verified restoration.
